events.description: Torque increased from 9 to 13 kft-lb at 2,912 m MD on entering Barail coal seams; stick-slip observed and ROP dropped from 9 to 4 m/hr.
events.mitigation: Reduced WOB/RPM, circulated bottoms-up and added lubricant to the mud system.
events.lesson_learned: Upper Barail coal seams produce torque spikes 20-40 m below the top; pre-condition the mud before entering.

events.description: Pipe became stuck while making connection at 2,940 m MD in Barail shale/coal sequence. Overpull to 85 klbs, no rotation. Worked pipe with jarring for 4.5 hrs; freed after spotting 30 bbl lubricant pill. Torque had risen from 9 to 14 kft-lb over the preceding 60 m.
events.mitigation: Increased circulation before connections; short reaming intervals; improved hole conditioning with hi-vis sweeps.
events.lesson_learned: Rising torque trend in upper Barail is a precursor to stuck pipe; ream every stand and keep jars armed below 2,900 m.
